assignment_rule: Every source candidate is assigned to exactly one atomic row. Independent reproductions of one mechanism share one row. Prior reuse and PR-117-remediated harness defects are excluded from the new-open census.

atomic_findings.error_claim: The live manuscript treats x_C=0 as sufficient for FLRW.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: The intended use is the forward FLRW limit under tacit physical assumptions.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: A stored signed-cancellation witness has x_C=0 with nonzero anisotropic components, so the converse fails as written.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Prove an iff statement with explicit hypotheses and reject the cancellation witness by a named premise.
atomic_findings.maximum_claim_tier: C1 formal limit; no FLRW certificate

atomic_findings.error_claim: Zero matter-radiation displacement is used as the EGS isotropy hypothesis.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: It is intended as a representative comoving specialization.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: The repository's orthogonal Bianchi-I witness has beta=0 and nonzero shear; the digest-blind referee reproduced the counterexample.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: State and check the full EGS radiation-isotropy, congruence and regularity hypotheses.

atomic_findings.error_claim: The exact parent theorem bypasses the later frame-vorticity repair.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: Frame contracts are documented in adjacent code and prose.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: The load-bearing theorem does not import those premises, so its consumers retain the stronger statement.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Bind the exact theorem to the repaired frame contract and test a vorticity counterexample.

atomic_findings.error_claim: A corrected NT-A3 estimator floor reappears as a universal cosmic-variance floor.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: The number is a useful one-estimator benchmark.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: The proof/table and digest-blind direct run give estimator-dependent values, including an L20 floor 0.423608 rather than universal 0.632.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Derive estimator-independent minimax coverage or relabel every site as estimator-specific.

atomic_findings.error_claim: NT2-B1 implements the reciprocal of its proved coefficient.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: The qualitative nonzero/sign conclusion remains.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: A direct witness yields the reciprocal scaling and propagates into the cone-shell and F endpoint.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Two independent engines must reproduce the printed coefficient for randomized admissible inputs.

atomic_findings.error_claim: A near-FLRW linear OMK coefficient is described as globally exact.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: The class-conditional linear coefficient and mechanical firewall pass.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: The nonlinear equality is false outside the controlled expansion; six ceilings inherit the stronger wording.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Prove an error-controlled domain or remove global-exact language and propagate the expansion remainder.

atomic_findings.error_claim: Convergence beyond L=40 is used to infer sufficiency of (a2,a3).
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: Higher multipoles are numerically small in the tested truncation.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: Small truncation error does not establish a factorization theorem or conditional-distribution sufficiency.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Provide a statistical sufficiency proof for the declared model family.

atomic_findings.error_claim: Global quadratic Omega_tilt and a local linear deprojection proxy share one name and are consumed as a measurement bridge.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: Local code paths are individually typed and intended as sensitivity coordinates.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: Manuscript/rank consumers erase the distinction; under the physical definition a quadratic downstream term changes order from beta^2 to beta^4.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Use distinct symbols/types and demonstrate response-rank separation with matched local/global injections.

atomic_findings.error_claim: The D2 bit-identity claim has no executable current Rust authority; the documented selector runs zero tests.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: The golden constant and Python regression preserve the historical value.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: A stored constant is not an independent executable authority for the production-physics anchor.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Run a nonzero independent Rust target and bind its source/input/output hashes.

atomic_findings.error_claim: Active TEFF ownership contradicts the controlling legacy-only contract.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: The mechanical firewall passes and TEFF remains scoped below a full solver.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: Passing tests currently require the prohibited active owner, so they certify the ownership regression.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Move TEFF to legacy-only reproduction and make active-owner imports fail the contract suite.

atomic_findings.error_claim: The shared-cause Bayes factor is a fitted log-likelihood difference and is not reproducible from HEAD.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: It is an exploratory shared-cause score awaiting normalized priors.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: The shipped +29.7 becomes -1035.461 at HEAD and no marginal likelihood is computed.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Register normalized priors/likelihoods and reproduce marginal evidence with two engines.

atomic_findings.error_claim: The 0/500 structured-null green is driven by a fixed direction penalty and wrong statistic.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: The gate conservatively rejects all tested structured nulls.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: Null means near -3893 to -3899 contradict the manuscript median near -3 and do not calibrate the intended evidence statistic.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Generate exchangeable structured-null data and calibrate the same authenticated statistic used on data.

atomic_findings.error_claim: Plug-in residual comparisons are labelled posterior predictive checks without posterior draws.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: They are useful deterministic residual sanity checks.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: No posterior predictive distribution or replicated-data discrepancy is generated, yet the label feeds readiness.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Draw replicated data from the posterior and calibrate declared discrepancies.

atomic_findings.error_claim: Two-channel evidence ablation is called LOOCV without held-out observations or predictive scoring.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: Channel ablation probes sensitivity to information sources.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: It is not leave-one-observation-out cross-validation and has different exchangeability assumptions.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Define folds over exchangeable units and compute held-out log predictive density.

atomic_findings.error_claim: Prior/evidence readiness can be asserted without an authenticated prior or evidence calculation.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: The interface is designed to receive future prior-sensitivity summaries.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: Current allowed inputs can flip the score from -39.1 to +26.4 without a registered prior family or likelihood identity.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Bind prior family, normalization, likelihood hash and evidence receipt; reject unauthenticated summaries.

atomic_findings.error_claim: Duck-typed fabricated-ready objects can make composite adequacy green.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: Internal callers are expected to use generated report classes.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: The public function authenticates neither type nor report/input hashes, so its gate is fail-open at the interface.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Require typed signed receipts and reject synthetic namespaces or mismatched hashes.

atomic_findings.impact_object: shared max-scan API; P2 for current non-anomalous cards
atomic_findings.error_claim: The observed map and null maps are ranked asymmetrically through the K1 maximum scan.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: Current p-value shifts are small and remain non-anomalous.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: A 100000-trial experiment gives 5.790 percent size at nominal 5 percent.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Pool data and nulls exchangeably through the complete scan and demonstrate calibrated rank size.

atomic_findings.error_claim: An alpha=.05 projection is stacked with an uncalibrated IM interval and labelled im_95_ci.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: Both stages are individually conservative under their own conditions.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: No theorem or simulation establishes 95 percent coverage for the composed data-dependent procedure.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Demonstrate uniform finite-sample coverage for the full stacked algorithm.

atomic_findings.error_claim: F_Bayes has no joint measure, IDs, weights or pairing hash.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: Equal-weight positional pairing is a transparent diagnostic convention.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: A pairing permutation changes the mean by about 4.9x, so the measure is load-bearing and unrecorded.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Declare and hash a scientifically justified joint measure, IDs, weights and pairing.

atomic_findings.error_claim: A historical active registry calls response-conditional quantities unconditionally identified.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: Later reports state the response and transfer conditions.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: The old active surface remains consumable and contradicts the current identified-set contract.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Remove/alias the stale registry and require response-condition metadata at ingestion.

atomic_findings.error_claim: The imported CF4 monopole defect shifts live Omega_tilt and rapidity consumers by an order of magnitude.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: The constrained projection is algebraically stable and improves on-model injection recovery.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: The 94.155 km/s value is a sensitivity rather than corrected truth, yet Omega_tilt moves 4.073e-7 to 3.110e-8.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Validate the full raw-distance/selection/reconstruction model and propagate its joint posterior.

atomic_findings.error_claim: Depth and shell-monopole propagation invalidate the precision and 4.9-sigma comparison.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: Some depth cuts overlap modern central values under total uncertainty.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: Raw fits range 0.299 to 0.486 while shell-centred fits stay near 0.292 to 0.308 and same-data covariance is unestimated.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Fit a raw-distance hierarchical likelihood across preregistered depths with joint covariance and coverage.

atomic_findings.error_claim: The L=2..10 lane is outside the frozen 40<L<763 validation range and has zero raw QE inputs.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: Released alms and 402 local simulations support a same-release percentile.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: They cannot invert/calibrate the missing filtered-CMB/QE response, so sky-power is scientifically blocked.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: End-to-end raw QE injections with mask, response, mean field, N0/N1 and low-L coverage.

atomic_findings.error_claim: A hashed fsky=.788737 mask is recorded but not applied to the morphology calculation.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: A simple matched-mask sensitivity left the null conclusion stable.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: One naive sensitivity is not a calibrated masked-sky null or transfer treatment.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Apply the mask and transfer identically to data and matched end-to-end nulls.

atomic_findings.error_claim: The real K1 card bypasses the canonical alm/BiPoSH convention payload.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: Bespoke code uses internally consistent conventions.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: The bypass prevents contract-level parity with nulls and other observable consumers.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Route real and null alms through one canonical convention and parity test.

atomic_findings.error_claim: A hard-coded Planck axis/p-value remains consumable although K1 does not measure it and joint covariance/trials are absent.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: It is intended as a fixed-axis exploratory probe.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: The external package does not enforce that scope and the probe can double count correlated information.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Estimate the axis from the declared data path and calibrate joint covariance and trials.

atomic_findings.impact_object: release/promotion status; P2 for current null conclusion
atomic_findings.error_claim: The corrected local-GRF calculation remains blocked by absent exact-selection mocks while ticket/card surfaces disagree about readiness.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: The 400-mock alpha-refit result p=.683 is converged and non-anomalous.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: Local GRFs omit the exact BGS_ANY selection/window/non-Gaussian covariance and cannot discharge the controlling blocker.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Run the identical estimator on exact-selection EZ/Abacus mocks and unify all readiness surfaces.

atomic_findings.error_claim: The 14-anchor rerun lacks an authoritative raw row manifest; downloader sources include a dead endpoint and landing pages.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: The local seed deterministically regenerates 14 anchors.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: Determinism of an unbound seed does not establish authoritative observed-data provenance.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Bind every row to authoritative source, retrieval hash, object ID and transformation receipt.

atomic_findings.error_claim: Shared calibration covariance is omitted from the forecast.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: Sensitivity to 0.05 mag shared error leaves gain above one.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: The gain changes 1.060 to 1.047 and no joint covariance is sourced or validated.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Use a sourced hierarchical covariance with shared calibration and validate coverage.

atomic_findings.error_claim: A permissive coordinate-only match radius drives anchor count and gain.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: The chosen radius maximizes recovery in a sparse exploratory table.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: Changing 0.01 to 0.25 degrees moves matches 5 to 14 and gain 1.031 to 1.060 without identity/redshift validation.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Use object identity/redshift matching and preregistered tolerance sensitivity.

atomic_findings.error_claim: Published per-host distance-modulus errors are never consumed; a global one-third shrink drives the gain.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: The shrink is an explicit simplified scenario assumption.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: The card presents host-specific observed anchors; the digest-blind rerun found total-variance gain 1.05999 versus measurement-only 1.01127.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Consume per-host uncertainties in a validated hierarchical covariance and reproduce the gain.

atomic_findings.error_claim: Packaging tests pass while clean-CWD import htt.bass fails under the dual htt distributions.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: Documented repository-root PYTHONPATH execution works and representative imports pass.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: The exact BASS consumer fails outside repository path injection, reproduced by the audit and root probe.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: One clean install must import every declared owner namespace from an empty CWD without PYTHONPATH.

atomic_findings.error_claim: Freeze/package gates pass while canonical manifests and figure/result freshness fail, and their presence-only predicates accept invalid evidence.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: The green commands are deterministic disclosure checks and prose retains science blockers.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: Pass labels reach external handoff: five current and fifteen VER2 surfaces are stale, 31 figures/98 issues are quarantined, and sampled packaged manifests remain invalid.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: One fail-closed aggregator must require canonical validity, freshness and executed hashed test receipts; quarantine cannot satisfy pass.

atomic_findings.error_claim: Initial leak checks were serialization-dependent and early receipts used changing runner bytes.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: No actual public leak was found and every execution retained environment/stdout/stderr evidence.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: Minified JSON bypassed the first test and byte-level replay requires one frozen runner.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Semantic multi-format negative fixtures and one-hash final reruns must pass.
atomic_findings.remediation: Parsed JSON plus semantic YAML/Markdown/TeX fixtures pass; atomic command IDs use exclusive run directories and a locked ledger; every decisive input, the environment self-hash, and captured numeric payload is recomputed. All seven sealed_v2 receipts share runner hash sha256:614630a438c046418703ec07dd91cf2d305b7ce8962b27904960c4d588c3fa0c and one environment hash; ACT is BLOCKED_SCIENTIFIC rather than PASS.

atomic_findings.error_claim: The ACT injection omits the mask/reconstruction transfer.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: It is an alm-space mechanics test.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: It cannot validate sky power.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Run the matched QE transfer.

atomic_findings.error_claim: The cited 428 plus/minus 108 result uses a different estimator and cannot validate the repository weights.
atomic_findings.strongest_defense: Both estimate large-scale bulk flow from CF4-like data.
atomic_findings.rebuttal: Estimator mismatch is already within the imported comparison/provenance finding.
atomic_findings.decisive_falsifier: Compare matched estimators on matched catalogues.
